stories.title: Iran accuses French diplomats of 'infiltration'
stories.summary: Iran accuses French diplomats of 'infiltration' The Iranian government has accused two French diplomats of conducting an "infiltration and interference" operation inside Iran. The Iranian intelligence ministry alleged in a statement that the diplomats were discovered at a secret meeting place, and that documents found pointed to efforts to establish contacts and build networks elsewhere.  It further said contracts linked to the project carried the signature of a former French ambassador to Iran. The ministry did not provide evidence for this, and the French government has not yet commented.
